keyVerseDR: "Blessed are ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God." (Lk 6:20)

level1.title: Blessed Are You
level1.story: Jesus taught a big crowd on a flat place. He said, "Blessed are you who are poor and hungry." God takes care of them!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who did Jesus say is blessed?
How can you help someone poor or sad?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me care for others. Amen.

activity.title: Help the poor
activity.intro: God cares for the poor. Write 3 ways to help.
activity.label: Ways I can help the poor

level2.title: Blessings and Woes
level2.story: Jesus came down with the Twelve and stood on a level place, with a great crowd from all Judea. Lifting His eyes to His disciples, He said, "Blessed are ye poor, for yours is the kingdom of God." He said, "Blessed are ye that hunger now: for you shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for you shall laugh." Jesus said to rejoice when people hate you because of Him, for your reward is great in heaven. He warned, "Woe to you that are rich: for you have your consolation."
level2.keyLine: Blessed are ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why does Jesus call the poor blessed?
What does Jesus warn the rich about?
actions: Thank God for what I have
level2.prayer: Jesus, make me rich in what matters. Amen.

activity.title: Weighing it up
activity.intro: Weigh what lasts: God's blessings or things of this world?

art.mainBrief: Jesus on a level plain teaching a crowd with poor families
